_readme: Copy discord-tiers.json from the Discord setup script (discord/setup) to config/discord-tiers.json. Fill bmcLevelIds with each Buy Me a Coffee membership_level_id once known (/tiers in Discord lists unmatched levels); until then levels are matched by name. unknownLevelTier: the class for a level the file does not know. tourist: the free role (verified email, no payment; the membership sweep never removes it). elder: the Elder role (given after afterDays since the first link or Tourist grant, plus activeDaysRequired active days in the last activityWindowDays and no timeouts; creatorRoleIds may also create private rooms), the lobby voice channel that makes private rooms, and the Elder category. league: the Republic Esports League for /league (commissioner role, the league category for match rooms, the four team roles and the channels the bot posts in; leave it out to switch /league off). hobbies: one entry per hobby role for the #college picker; add "requires": "gaming" to the Esports League entry so it is only given with Gaming. voiceNotice.categoryIds: extra categories whose voice channels get the public-voice notice even without ambient sound.
